summary: Codenames: Duet is a two-player cooperative twist on Codenames, where both players see different secret agent maps and work together giving one-word clues to identify all agents within a limited number of turns before hitting an assassin. It transforms the competitive party game into a tense, collaborative puzzle for couples or pairs.
praised: clever cooperative redesign that works great for exactly two players
quick setup and replayability with the same box
great for partners/couples as a regular two-player game
criticised: loses the multiplayer party energy of the original
can be frustrating when you keep hitting near-misses
less appealing to groups who wanted the original's social banter

scoring.why: the team either finds all agents within the turn limit or loses by hitting an assassin, with no points involved

similar: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine
